cases.title: Transfer money to a saved payee
preconditions: The checking account balance is at least 500.00 USD.

steps.action: Select a payee and enter a reasonable amount.
steps.expected: The amount is shown in the Amount field.

expected: The balance decreases by the transfer amount.

steps.expected: The list of billers is displayed.
The bill amount due is shown.

steps.action: Tap Pay now or schedule the payment for later.

cases.title: Reject a transfer above the daily limit
preconditions: The daily transfer limit is 5,000.00 USD.

steps.action: Enter 6,000.00 in the Amount field and tap Send.
steps.expected: The message "Amount exceeds your daily limit" is displayed.

steps.action: Verify that no transaction appears in the Transactions screen.
